details: The dirty-flag + RAF pattern correctly coalesces canvas redraws, but the zoom handler calls updateVoronoi() synchronously on every zoom event, triggering a full Delaunay recomputation and D3 data join of 5000 SVG path elements without any debouncing or RAF coalescing — a clear update storm when Voronoi is enabled. Pointer events unify mouse/touch correctly, currentTransform is always current, and there is no cross-view dispatch feedback loop.
